# Steady 2.21.8

- Home: League and Usage open as their own apps (separate Recents cards) from grid icons only — removed from the overflow menu
- Home menu trimmed; SOS Call and Quick Focus promoted to always-visible quick actions
- Removed third-party AppWidget hosting from Steady Home (native glance cards only)
- App updates use the public website channel only — no embedded GitHub token for update checks/downloads
- Stronger PIN hashing (PBKDF2 600k) with auto-upgrade of legacy/weaker hashes on successful unlock
- Dashboard no longer injects third-party ad scripts next to signed-in session storage
- Crash upload path uses the resolved sync token and real app version
